verdicts.reason: Both are almost the same shrunk layout on a flat white background that drops the original's full-bleed gym photo. In both, 'BEST TRX EXERCISES' sits on top of the left photo's edge. The name and tagline bars hang off to the side at a different height from the headline, and the right photo is a tiny, crammed strip with fiddly yellow frame pieces. A is very slightly better because its tall yellow block sits behind the 'EX' letters where the text crosses the photo, which helps legibility. In B the yellow bars are broken up, so the letters sit directly on the busy image.
